'''Kentaro Yano''' (1 March 1912 in Tokyo, Japan – 25 December 1993) was a mathematician working on [[differential geometry]]<ref>{{cite journal|author=Suceavă, Bogdan D.|title=The Cartan connection: sketches for a portrait of Kentaro Yano|journal=Creative Mathematics and Informatics |year=2021|volume=29|issue=2|pages=237–242|url=https://www.creative-mathematics.cunbm.utcluj.ro/article/the-cartan-connection-sketches-for-a-portrait-of-kentaro-yano/|doi=10.37193/cmi.2020.02.15|doi-access=free|url-access=subscription}}</ref> who introduced the [[Bochner–Yano theorem]].

He also published a classical book about geometric objects (i.e., sections of [[Natural bundle|natural fiber bundle]]s) and [[Lie derivative]]s of these objects.

==Publications==
* Les espaces à connexion projective et la géométrie projective des paths, Iasi, 1938
* Geometry of Structural Forms (Japanese), 1947
* Groups of Transformations in Generalized Spaces, Tokyo, Akademeia Press, 1949
* with Salomon Bochner: [https://books.google.com/books?id=ykEZ5z5-5x8C Curvature and Betti Numbers], Princeton University Press, [[Annals of Mathematics Studies]], 1953<ref>{{cite journal|author=Boothby, William B.|title=Review: ''Curvature and Betti numbers'', by K. Yano and S. Bochner|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1954|volume=60|issue=4|pages=404–405|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1954-60-04/S0002-9904-1954-09834-8/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1954-09834-8|doi-access=free}}</ref>
* {{cite book|title=The Theory of Lie Derivatives and its Applications
|publisher=North-Holland|year=1957|isbn=978-0-7204-2104-0}} [https://books.google.com/books?id=V97YDwAAQBAJ 2020 reprint]
* Differential geometry on complex and almost complex spaces, Macmillan, New York 1965
* Integral formulas in Riemannian Geometry, Marcel Dekker, New York 1970
* with Shigeru Ishihara: Tangent and cotangent bundles: differential geometry, New York, M. Dekker 1973
* with Masahiro Kon: Anti-invariant submanifolds, Marcel Dekker, New York 1976<ref>{{cite journal|author=Reilly, Robert C.|title=Review: ''Anti-invariant subspaces'', by K. Yano and M. Kon|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1979|volume=1|issue=4|pages=627–632|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1979-01-04/S0273-0979-1979-14642-1/|doi=10.1090/s0273-0979-1979-14642-1|doi-access=free}}</ref>
* [[Morio Obata]] (ed.): [https://books.google.com/books?id=5MV0Yrx4dHYC Selected papers of Kentaro Yano], North Holland 1982
* with Masahiro Kon: CR Submanifolds of Kählerian and Sasakian Manifolds, Birkhäuser 1983<ref>{{cite journal|author=Chen, Bang-Yen|title=Review: ''CR submanifolds of Kaehlerian and Sasakian manifolds'', by K. Yano and M. Kon|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. (N.S.)|year=1983|volume=9|issue=3|pages=361–364|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1983-09-03/S0273-0979-1983-15209-6/|doi=10.1090/s0273-0979-1983-15209-6|doi-access=free}}</ref> [https://books.google.com/books?id=uK7bBwAAQBAJ 2012 reprint]
* with Masahiro Kon: Structures on Manifolds, World Scientific 1984
